notes: Stability and clean IPs. Fixes the main causes of the 1101 error: a failed connection retry could escape as an unhandled error after the connection was established; the debug logger could throw during cleanup and leak a connection slot and socket on every failed probe; an accepted WebSocket that never sent data was held open indefinitely; and unauthenticated requests could stall the worker or trigger large outbound bursts (which also risks a Cloudflare abuse flag). Adds IRCF per-ISP clean IPs (validated as real Cloudflare edges), records connection-level errors in the panel diagnostics, adds missing database indexes, and explains why an over-quota user cannot be re-enabled. Includes 4.5.x and 4.4.x.
